title: Canonical vector-purity finite-reduction equation
statement: In [def-pur-conventions], for the normalized gamma of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization], define compatibility with every quotient phi:A_(E,n)→A_(E,m), 1≤m≤n. Let Q be the derived sheaf scalar tensor [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with the existing fixed scalar adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. The ordinary Tate-line comparison is fixed by sending a tensor z to phi(a) tensor z. The scalar-source arrow a is the composite of the K-flat-normalized scalar tensorator of [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison], the scalar shift comparison, the Tate-power map (whose rank-zero and degree-zero pieces are the canonical scalar/single and normalized unit maps of [def-pur-vector-purity-scalar-single]) and the scalar/pullback comparison of [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Let q:Q_B Rpi_!,n→Rpi_!,m Q_E be the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison of [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison] on the chosen compactification (the scalar mate of the proper part at the open extension, followed by proper direct image of the open comparison). At each bounded constructible finite-Tor K and at the coefficient-unit OBJECT, assert invertibility of q at Rpi_n^!K and let b:Q_E Rpi_n^!K→Rpi_m^!Q_BK be the published geometric adjunct of q^{-1}≫Q_B(epsilon_n) of the same node. Require a,b invertible and Q_E(gamma_n,K)≫b=a≫gamma_m,Q_BK, with gamma_m separately integration-normalized.
